arunachal_pradesh.calibration_note: PDLS_2024_50185.pdf: automated n_date_of_initiation=4 exactly matched manual read of 4 distinct events. 5 more narrative reports (Bomdila 1973, Jamiri/Munna Camp 1989, Minutang 1948, Bhalukpong 2016, NH-313 Abrali 2024) spot-verified by direct reading.

verdict.arunachal_alone: Still short of what a trustworthy ML trigger model needs — same conclusion as at 72 events (5-fold CV would leave too few per fold).
verdict.himalayan_pooled: A different regime — enough to seriously attempt a properly cross-validated tree-based model (not deep learning), trained on the pool and fine-tuned to Arunachal.
verdict.deep_learning: Not justified at this scale either way; would want low thousands, and rainfall input resolution is a separate limiting factor.

next_step_not_done: Read the ~176 flagged reports (20 Arunachal + 156 regional) one at a time and extract each into a structured event table. data/interim/gsi_reports/scan_results.json is the exact queue — filter has_date_signal: true. PDFs are not cached in the repo (re-download via the script; URLs are deterministic from state/type/accession-number).
